issues.description: default_raise() sentinel kept as required-field marker after kw_only landed, weakening the contract
issues.detail: With kw_only=True universally available, required fields can simply omit defaults. Retaining field(default_factory=default_raise) raises RuntimeError at construct time instead of TypeError at the call boundary, and leaves a leaky abstraction whose stated <3.10 rationale no longer applies. Remove the sentinel and let dataclass machinery express required-ness natively.

issues.description: Ruff UP045/UP007/UP035 blanket-ignored, deferring the Union -> | migration this PR advertises
issues.detail: The PR's stated value (dropping 3.9 to modernize types) is contradicted by ruff.toml ignoring exactly the rules that would enforce A | None. A repo-wide ignore with an open TODO leaves the codebase in a two-dialect state indefinitely. Either land the codemod now or scope the ignore to specific paths so new code is held to the new shape.

issues.description: Install scripts hardcode python3.12 instead of tracking the supported version floor or matrix
issues.detail: Amazon/Rocky prep was changed from discoverable python to forcing python3.12, while the matrix still tests 3.10/3.11/3.12. Additionally install.sh's PYTHON_MINOR_VER -lt 7 predicate still admits 3.7-3.9 even though the error message says >= 3.10. Align the predicate, message, and matrix so coverage matches intent.

issues.description: Stale '< 3.10 compatibility' comment block remains above TransactionEndpointRequest
issues.detail: The comment still explains default_factory=default_raise as a <3.10 workaround, but the kw_only_dataclass shim is gone. The documentation and code now disagree about why the pattern exists. Either remove default_raise outright (preferred) or update the comment to state the real invariant.

issues.description: Noisy 'dnf search python3.12' left in install workflow prep steps
issues.detail: The Amazon/Rocky prep runs dnf search before install, which is diagnostic noise that doesn't affect the install postcondition and can mask real failures. Keep the prep deterministic by dropping the search and installing only what's required.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a structurally clean Python 3.9 removal — mostly subtraction, kw_only consolidation is a real simplification, and no LSP violations were introduced. But the migration is half-finished: default_raise() persists as a required-field sentinel even though kw_only now expresses required-ness natively, and ruff.toml blanket-ignores the exact UP rules that would enforce the Union -> | style the PR advertises. Install-side changes hardcode python3.12 and leave the install.sh version predicate misaligned with its error message. Stale <3.10 comments and a diagnostic dnf search round out the cleanup debt. Finish removing the 3.9 fingerprints before they ossify.
